twiddle_rule: Radix2 DIT stage m=2^s; j=0..m/2-1; exp(-i*2*pi*j/m); DIT bitreversal input required for natural order output

width_corrections.correct_exact_continuous_envelope: Qreq=ceil(M*2^F); unsigned W=max(1,Qreq.bit_length()); signed W=max(2,1+Qreq.bit_length()) for continuous [-M,M] enclosing quantizer values
width_corrections.explicit_quantized_integer_bound: for raw integer bound K>=0 exact: unsigned W=max(1,K.bit_length()), signed symmetric W=max(2,1+K.bit_length())
width_corrections.legacy_numeric_tables: v0.2 computed main ideal numeric boundary widths were rechecked; differences or loose bounds listed in report; v0.2 files preserved
width_corrections.negative_minimum_note: signed min -2^(W-1) representable; +2^(W-1) NOT, hence symmetric +/-2^(W-1) needs W+1
width_corrections.previous_signed_float_log_expression: F+1+ceil(log2(M+2^-F)), sensitive to float boundary rounding and symmetry constraints
width_corrections.previous_unsigned_expression: F+floor(log2(M))+1, correct only for positive real M with careful exact powers and boundary handling; floating log can mis-round
